elements.evidence: "will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months" (both the Agreement and, as amended, the Attachment)

elements.element: Customer may opt out of renewal on 30 days' notice
elements.evidence: "unless IBM gives 30 days' written notice ... of its intent to terminate this Agreement"
"MSL shall notify IBM in writing not less than 60 days before the end of the then-current term of the upcoming renewal"

elements.element: Renewal price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%
elements.evidence: "any price increase for a renewal period shall not exceed the lesser of CPI and 3%"

elements.element: Automatic renewal with non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days (Customer side)
elements.evidence: "unless IBM gives 30 days' written notice" — 30 days ≤ 60 days
cap at "the lesser of CPI and 3%" is within the ≤5% ceiling

reasons: All four preferred atomic elements are present in operative text: 12-month automatic renewal terms, a 30-day Customer (IBM) opt-out, a mandatory 60-day MSL reminder, and a renewal price cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

Edits are surgical: two targeted replacements of the notice/renewal-period language and one concise inserted sentence supplying the absent reminder and price-cap mechanics; MSL's own notice period and the unchanged sentences (term length, successive-periods language, Section 5.0 termination rights) remain effective.
Changing the Attachment's renewal period from six (6) to twelve (12) months is required by the preferred position's 12-month renewal cycle, so it is not an extraneous change.

Minor, rationale-only notes: 'CPI' is used without a defined index/measurement period, and the reminder/price-cap sentence is inserted only after the Base Agreement term paragraph, so its application to the Attachment renewals depends on incorporation by reference rather than express repetition.
